Set up your tournament in minutes. Fill in the details below and we'll generate a unique tournament code to get you started.

div.label: Upload Logo
div.p: PNG or JPG recommended · Shown on player cards & live board

div.label: Theme *
div.p: Choose how your player cards will look. Select a theme to preview a sample card below.
Sample Card Preview

div.label: Tournament Poster (Optional)
div.p: Displayed on the player registration page so players know what they're signing up for.
Click to upload a poster image · PNG / JPG

div.span: Enable if your tournament committee provides jerseys to players. This adds Name on Jersey, Jersey Number and Jersey Size fields to the player registration form.

div.strong: Show Player Contact on Card / Presentation
div.span: When enabled, players' mobile numbers are visible on printed cards and the live auction display. Keep disabled for privacy.

div.label: Total Player Registrations Allowed
div.p: Set to 0 for unlimited. Registration closes automatically when the limit is reached.

div.label: WhatsApp Group Link (Optional)
div.p: Paste your players' WhatsApp group invite URL here. A "Join WhatsApp Group" button will appear on the registration success screen.

div.label: Tournament Rules

textarea.name: rules_regulations
textarea.placeholder: 1. All players must report 30 minutes before the match. 2. No objectionable language or behaviour. 3. Umpire decisions are final...

div.p: Plain text rules shown in the backend. You can update detailed HTML rules from the tournament record later.

div.label: Payment QR / Scanner (Optional)
div.p: Upload your UPI QR code or payment scanner. Players can scan it directly from the registration page.

div.label: Payment Instructions (Optional)

textarea.name: payment_instruction
textarea.placeholder: e.g. Pay ₹500 via UPI to 9876543210@paytm and attach the screenshot below.

div.p: These instructions are shown to players on the registration form under the payment proof upload.
